text:
liz: Quick kickoff 10-min thread1 1 preparing a compact package for AWS/GCP/Azure listings. Goal: one manifest template, one EULA snippet, and a single compressed hero + thumbnail set. Who can pick up manifest template?

omar: I can own the manifest template. Prefer a CSV that maps sku, cloud, offer_id, plan_id, visibility. Will draft and push to Drive by EOD.

frank: FYI on naming: avoid generic RED-PRO across clouds. Suggest RED-PRO-{cloud}-{tier} to prevent collisions with experiments.

sara: I'll do the EULA/snippet. Need to confirm trial behavior: are we doing auto-convert or require explicit checkout?

legal-bot: automated-check: 14-day trial with explicit opt-in conversion is fine; flag: include data deletion and KMS mention for private offers.

liz: Good point. Let's do 14d trial + explicit conversion to paid (user clicks convert). Add data deletion line linking to /privacy/marketplace.

image-bot: asset-check: AWS hero 3:2 max 1MB, GCP banner 16:9 max 750KB, Azure thumbnail 1:1 max 500KB. Recommend PNG for clarity, JPG for size.

omar: I'll include cloud-specific offer_id and plan_id columns for Azure in the CSV. Will mark RED-BETA internal-only excluded.

frank: For metering, keep it simple: trial SKU + paid SKU per cloud. We can add per-seat meters later.

sara: Drafted EULA snippet: "Trial term 14 days. Customer data retained for service operation; upon request Redwood removes data within 30 days. Private offers may use customer KMS for key management." Dropped to docs/legal/marketplace-eula-draft.md. Tagging legal.

legal-bot: automated-check passed. Manual review scheduled if any edits required.

liz: Action items: 1) Omar: manifest CSV with offer_id/plan_id + exclude list (EOD). 2) Sara: finalize EULA snippet with link to privacy FAQ (tomorrow AM). 3) Frank: confirm SKU naming pattern + push a short blurb (tomorrow). 4) Image-bot / design: compress images and add alt text (tomorrow). Preflight: Thu 9:30am PT.

omar: Got it. I'll ping when CSV is in Drive and will include a sample manifest header: `sku,cloud,offer_id,plan_id,visibility,notes`.

sara: Will add privacy link and tag legal.

frank: I'll write the blurb (3 bullets) and CTAs: "Start free 14 days", "Request demo", "Talk to sales". Recommend using "Start free 14 days" for marketplace.

liz: Nice. Thanks all 1 closing thread; reopen if blockers appear. :white_check_mark:
